answer: Random mutual audit stops fake identities. Each epoch, each identity gets 3 random peer auditors. One verifies a juniper cutting was propagated. Another checks a trellis was built to spec. A third grades a jade carving for quality. Auditors passing a fake lose their deposit. Faking 100 identities needs 300 audits; at 20 credits each, that is 6,000 credits, far above the 900-credit gain. Honest agents pay one fee and keep undiluted rewards.
